title: Mag-7 AI Services revenue-line breakout sets canonical disclosure precedent by Q3 2026
body: By Q3 2026 the Mag-7 AI Services revenue-line breakout settles as the canonical disclosure convention across all seven names — Microsoft fiscal-Q3 print plus Meta plus Amazon Web Services fiscal-Q3 prints in the back half of June followed by the late-Q3 cycle covering Apple, Nvidia, Tesla, and the second Alphabet print — anchored by the now-published Alphabet analyst-day deck plus its updated investor-presentation footnotes as the canonical disclosure-precedent document set against which the SEC Corp Fin fourth sample comment letter language is now operationally fitted. The Saturday weekend snapshot closes the trading week with the breakout-cohort probability sitting at its highest reading inside one percentage point of unanimity. A Saturday 247 Wall St week-recap note reports the Bernstein, Wells Fargo Securities, Evercore ISI, Citi Research, Jefferies, and Goldman Sachs Equity Research preview cohort holding the Mag-7 breakout-cohort probability at Friday's 97 percent reading — the highest the cohort has carried and the first weekend reading inside one percentage point of unanimity — with the Saturday week-recap notes treating the now-published Alphabet analyst-day deck plus its updated investor-presentation footnotes as the settled disclosure-precedent document set the upcoming Microsoft fiscal-Q3 print can be benchmarked against. A Saturday VentureBeat aggregation reports the cohort confirming the Microsoft fiscal-Q3 print's expected disclosure-precedent commentary in the back half of June with Meta and AWS following inside their fiscal-Q3 prints, and notes that the Memorial Day three-day weekend's market closure pushes the next concrete tape session to Tuesday May 26 — extending the standard pre-weekend signal-to-noise settling period into a three-day window. The Saturday week-recap cohort cites the cleared Frontier Model Review Board classified-annex eight-of-eight record plus the cleared CISA federal-civilian operational directive compliance-monitoring phase together as the doubly-cleared regulatory-anchor backdrop against which the AI Services revenue-line breakout commentary can land without overhanging risk-factor questions, and the cohort flags that with the now-eight-document loader-verification reference set settled as the framework default-shipment anchor heading into mid-June, the disclosure-precedent footprint extends into auditable AI-services attestation arithmetic the Q3 prints can cite as material-line substantiation. The structural force is that once the breakout-cohort probability holds at 97 percent inside one percentage point of unanimity across the weekend hold, the Alphabet analyst-day deck plus its investor-presentation footnotes settle as the canonical disclosure-precedent document set, the SEC Corp Fin fourth sample comment letter language operationally fits the now-published Alphabet shape, the Microsoft fiscal-Q3 print sits as the next benchmarkable disclosure window in the back half of June with Meta and AWS following, and the doubly-cleared FMRB plus CISA regulatory backdrop removes the standing risk-factor overhang, the AI Services revenue-line breakout compresses to a disclosure-cycle execution detail rather than an underwriting question. The most likely landing is all seven Mag-7 names adopting a separately-broken-out AI Services revenue line by Q3 2026 — Microsoft fiscal-Q3 print in the back half of June leads, Meta and AWS follow inside their fiscal-Q3 prints, Apple plus Nvidia plus Tesla plus the second Alphabet print close the cycle in late Q3 — with the SEC Corp Fin sixth sample comment letter expected to formalize the convention as standing industry practice and the Tenstorrent plus SambaNova plus a third-name AI-accelerator IPO comparable set pricing against the now-settled disclosure shape rather than against a forward-looking expectation. Bear case is one of the back-half-June print cohorts deferring its breakout to its fiscal-Q4 print citing footnote-substantiation timing and the cohort probability slipping back below 95 percent on the deferral session; absent that slip, Q3 2026 lands the Mag-7 AI Services revenue-line breakout as the canonical disclosure convention.

reasoning.so_that: All seven Mag-7 names adopt separately-broken-out AI Services revenue lines as canonical disclosure convention.
reasoning.landing: By Q3 2026; Microsoft leads in back-half June, Meta and AWS follow, late Q3 closes the cycle.
reasoning.plain_language: Big tech companies will start reporting how much money their AI businesses make as a separate line on their earnings reports by late 2026.

summary: Saturday holds the Mag-7 breakout-cohort probability at 97 percent inside one percentage point of unanimity, with the Alphabet analyst-day deck plus its investor-presentation footnotes settled as the canonical disclosure-precedent document set against a doubly-cleared regulatory backdrop. By Q3 2026 all seven Mag-7 names adopt a separately-broken-out AI Services revenue line as standing disclosure convention.
